title: reportd's log file exists, but writes to it never stick
description_md:
`reportd`'s config points its logging at `/var/log/reportd/reportd.log`, and that path is right there when you `ls` it -- but nothing reportd writes ever actually shows up when you read it back. The app never complains, never errors, just keeps running as if everything's fine. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out where writes to that path are actually going, and fix it so they land somewhere real.

You're done when a line written through reportd's logger actually shows up when you read back `/var/log/reportd/reportd.log`.
